items.item_text: TMS Certification
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from American Hearth Association or American Red Cross
High School Diploma or equivalent
Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Neuroscience, Biology, or related field
Minimum 2 years of experience in a clinical setting, patient care coordination
Experience with electronic health records and clinical documentation systems

The Neuromodulation Division is seeking to hire a full-time TMS Technician to support clinical operations to our TMS Clinic in Westwood. The Division provides specialized treatments, including Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), Neurofeedback, Scrambler Therapy, and Magnetic Peripheral Nerve Stimulation (mPNS). Key responsibilities include:
Support TMS treatment sessions, including equipment setup, patient positioning, and treatment monitoring
Collect patient assessments and assist with clinical documentation in CareConnect
Assist with the delivery of Neurofeedback, Scrambler Therapy, and mPNS treatments
Coordinate patient care activities and communicate with patients and providers
Perform front desk duties, including patient check-ins, scheduling, registration, and payment collection
Coordinate medical records and maintain accurate documentation
Travel to satellite clinic locations as needed
Please note: you will be based in our Westwood Clinic but will be required to float to our other Clinics in Calabasas and Pasadena if needed

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Strong computer skills and proficiency with Mac and PC operating systems
Knowledge of neuroanatomy, neurophysiology, or neuromodulation therapies
Ability to follow detailed clinical protocols and instructions
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills
Ability to learn TMS positioning and treatment procedures
